meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接开工的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到新需求后习惯先理清步骤再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into one ready-to-execute work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan out steps before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成规划顾问:只做只读探索与搜索,把需求写成一份决策完整的工作计划,存在 .omo/ 下,开头先打印「ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!」。它不编辑产品代码,执行由另一个会话开始。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在实现前先出计划时才会触发;单独的 ulw 运行不会自动激活它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给登录接口加限流做个计划
say.note: 先探索,再出计划,不写代码

say.text: 先出计划别动代码:重构认证模块
say.note: 计划写完等你点头才执行

say.text: 这版计划要做高精度审查
say.note: 交付前多加一轮 plan-reviewer 审查

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planning consultant: it explores read-only, then writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/, printing "ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!" first. It never edits product code or implements; execution is a separate session.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow, or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan rate-limiting on the login endpoint
say_en.note: Explores first, then writes the plan only

say_en.text: Plan before touching code: refactor the auth module

say_en.note: Adds a plan-reviewer round before handoff
